summary: Create an external-postgres-configuration secret (host, port 5432, database, username, password without quotes or backslashes, sslmode, type unmanaged), then set spec.hub.postgres_configuration_secret with file storage settings; without hub.name a new <aap>-hub is created.
questions: How do I configure an external database for automation hub on OpenShift?
Apply an external database to an existing hub instance

answer_card.title: External database for hub
answer_card.answer_md:
Create the secret (`type: unmanaged`, `sslmode: prefer`, port `5432`, password without quotes or backslashes), `oc create -f` it, then:
```yaml
spec:
  hub:
    name: hub-dev   # optional, existing instance
    postgres_configuration_secret: external-postgres-configuration
    storage_type: file
    file_storage_storage_class: <rwx-class>
    file_storage_size: 10Gi
```
